regime_context: The detector shows a broad, non-directional rotation with Silver & Royalties narrowly leading Gold Miners (margin 0.137, both eligible, both scorable via XGD.TO). Absolute trend gate helps on this market's history, so the only validated edge is drawdown control; momentum rank is a focus lens (rank-IC ~0), and track_record shows 59.7% hits but only 30.6% directional accuracy — so leans should be modest and conditionally framed.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Gold Miners closes the narrow 0.137 score gap to Silver & Royalties while Silver & Royalties' breadth stays at 1.0 — a confirmed handoff would require Gold Miners to take rank 1 with a durability_bar above 0.7 and breadth 1.0 for at least 5 consecutive sessions; retire the watch if the margin widens back above 0.3.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties holds the top momentum rank (score 2.11) with durability_bar 0.7, breadth 1.0, and a non-crowded z-score of 0.94. It is eligible under the absolute-trend gate. This is a trend-following, gate-disciplined lean on the prevailing leadership, not a prediction of return — supported by the rank, durability, and gate legs.
evidence: gate_helps=true (validated risk control on this market)
theses.dissent: Silver & Royalties and Gold Miners share the same proxy (XGD.TO), so there is no clean separation of leadership; the marginal lead over Gold Miners (0.137) is thin and may persist only if precious metals breadth holds, not because of any durable silver-specific demand.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX over any rolling 5-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is rank 2 (score 1.973), eligible under the absolute-trend gate, with durability_bar 0.75 (highest among leaders) and breadth 1.0, non-crowded (z=0.73). As the challenger to Silver & Royalties, it shares the precious-metals momentum and has comparable trend health, making a modest conditional overweight defensible.
evidence: challenger to leader with thin margin 0.137
theses.dissent: Gold Miners and Silver & Royalties both proxy to XGD.TO, so an overweight on each is effectively one call on precious metals; if real yields firm and gold stalls, both ranks collapse together with no diversification.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper is rank 3 (score 1.678) and eligible under the trend gate, but it is flagged crowded (z=1.23, crowded=true). Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — this translates to avoiding new overweight here rather than a fade or short, given no basket-level forward edge on the crowding leg.
evidence: guardrails: crowding only DOWN-SIZES, never a fade/short
theses.dissent: Copper and base metals could continue trending on supply tightness and electrification demand; the crowding flag is coincident and has no validated forward edge on basket drawdown, so avoiding it may forgo a legitimate trend.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO sustains outperformance versus the S&P/TSX while its crowding_z remains above 1.2 through the check-by date
